implementation: Advertise incremental UTF-16 synchronization while retaining full-buffer replacement
Apply mixed full/ranged changes in sequence and commit text/version once per notification
Map LF, CRLF and standalone CR lines, clamp overlong columns and reject split surrogate pairs
Validate optional deprecated rangeLength against replaced UTF-16 units
Reject malformed ranges and edit byte/count/work overages without partial updates
Align structured diagnostic positions with standalone CR editor lines

coverage: Concrete unit edit results over BMP/supplementary Unicode and LF/CRLF/CR
Sequential and mixed replacements, empty no-op updates and EOF insertion
Overlong column clamping, nonexistent lines, reversed ranges and surrogate boundaries
UTF-16 rangeLength including CRLF and rejected mismatches
Atomic rejection after an earlier valid edit; retry at the same version succeeds
Negative, fractional and large protocol positions, null ranges and excessive event counts
Incremental dependency signature changes recheck open importers
Byte/work/count limits, invalid UTF-8 helper inputs and diagnostic CR positions
Existing LSP lifecycle/framing, overlays, checker diagnostics and frontend regression suites
qualification.third_party_sanitization: LLVM libraries are not rebuilt with sanitizers

edit_limits.work_charge: original bytes once, replacement bytes plus one per event, current buffer bytes for each ranged event
edit_limits.byte_limit: remaining shared open-buffer budget at every intermediate state

limitations: Simple bounded scan/copy edits; no rope/index optimization
Full compiler rechecks after each committed notification; parsing is not incremental
Synchronous checks without debounce, background cancellation or queued-edit coalescing
No real-editor or additional operating-system qualification
No hover/navigation/completion/formatting implementation in this milestone
